(Japanese: '''運命の出会いちゃも!?''' ''A Destined Meeting (chamo!?)'') is the first true chapter of the [[Pokémon Chamo-Chamo ☆ Pretty ♪]] manga.

==Plot==
{{TP|Haruka|Torchic}} and {{CCP|Haruka}} have just moved to a new town, and Torchic is eager to meet her Prince Charming. She is disappointed to then meet a scatterbrained {{TP|Hazel|Pikachu}} and {{TP|Hazel|Clefairy}}, as well as a rude {{TP|Kanata|Poochyena}}. 

After arguing with Poochyena, Torchic storms off into the woods, where she suddenly finds herself surrounded by {{p|Silcoon}} and {{p|Cascoon}}. Panicked, she blasts them with {{m|Ember}}, but stops when she hears a voice reassuring her that she is safe. The voice is revealed to belong to {{TP|Kanata|Mightyena}}, and Torchic is instantly smitten with him. He lets her climb onto his back, then carries her out of the forest and back into the town. Upon their return, she learns that Mightyena is Poochyena's older brother.

Having met Mightyena, Torchic decides she will enjoy living in her new town.

==Major events==
* Haruka and Torchic move to their new town and meet new friends.
* Torchic falls in love with {{TP|Kanata|Mightyena}} and starts her rivalry with Poochyena.
